pairs.name: glow
pairs.alt: The rainy night street with neon signs, original left and with Glow at its default values right: the pink spiral, the cyan and orange signs and the shop lights get soft halos in their own colours, and the lamps in the distance bloom into the wet air
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: the default values (Amount 2.5, Threshold 0.95, Radius 80 px).

pairs.name: glow-threshold
pairs.alt: The dancer on the dark stage with Glow twice: at Threshold 0.95 left only the spotlight and the brightest folds of her dress glow, at Threshold 0.55 right her whole dress, arms and face shine with a soft white halo
pairs.caption: Left: Threshold 0.95, the default. Right: Threshold 0.55.

pairs.name: sheen
pairs.alt: The dancer on a dark stage, original left and with Sheen at its default values right: a soft white band of light crosses the picture from the lower left to the upper right, brightest along its middle and fading to both sides, strongest on her light dress while the folds of the fabric stay visible
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Sheen at its default settings.

pairs.name: sheen-highlights
pairs.alt: The dancer with Sheen twice: at Highlights 0 left the band lights the dark stage behind her as a grey haze as much as her dress, at Highlights 1 right the dark stage stays dark and only her light dress, arms and face catch the band
pairs.caption: Left: Highlights 0, the same light everywhere. Right: Highlights 1, only bright surfaces catch it.

pairs.name: vignette
pairs.alt: The harbour town in daylight, original left and with Vignette at its default values right: the sky, the mountains and the boats darken softly towards all four corners, while the houses and the harbour in the middle keep their brightness
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: the default values (Amount 0.5, Size 0.5, Softness 0.5, Roundness 1).

pairs.name: vignette-roundness
pairs.alt: The harbour town with a strong Vignette twice: at Roundness 1 left the light falls in a circle that leaves the left and right thirds of the frame dark, at Roundness 0 right it is a wide oval that follows the frame and darkens mostly the corners
pairs.caption: Amount 1, Size 0.45, Softness 0.25. Left: Roundness 1, a circle. Right: Roundness 0, the shape of the frame.

pairs.name: edge-detect
pairs.alt: The harbour town in daylight, original left and with Edge Detect at its default values right: the houses, boats, mountain ridge and clouds become fine white lines on black, and the calm water and sky stay dark
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: the default values (Strength 1, Width 1 px, Color 0, Invert off).

pairs.name: edge-detect-width
pairs.alt: The dancer as outlines twice: at Width 1 left thin lines trace her hair, the folds of her dress and every pebble of the floor, at Width 4 right a few thick soft lines follow only her body, arms and the large folds
pairs.caption: Left: Width 1 px, every fine detail. Right: Width 4 px, only the big shapes.
